d: The Spurs defeated the Trail Blazers, 125-103 tonight in Portland. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 7 rebounds 3 assists and 3 three pointers, with Devin Vassell of the Spurs adding an additional 15 points (4-8 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Deni Avdija finished with a team-high 15 points along with 4 rebounds for the Trail Blazers in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 8-2 with the win, while the Trail Blazers fall to 6-3 for the season.
